_comment: Synthetic G36 RCx cause-chain fleet (generator g36_rcx_chains, camber/datasets/_synthetic_g36_rcx_chains.py; 0.108) -> CAMBER Role mapping for one air handler: the columns of synthetic_g36_fleet_ahu.json (OAT, SF_STS, OCC, SAT, SAT_SP, SAT_REQ, DSP, DSP_SP, DSP_REQ, all CAMBER's own) plus SF_SPD, the supply fan's speed in %, and CLG_VLV, the cooling valve in %. The scenario column selects one air handler per ingest run and is not a point.
